product.title: Yellowstone Lower Loop Full-Day Tour

description.text: Tour the lower loop of Yellowstone National Park with an expert guide on this all-day tour. Visit popular sites like Old Faithful, Grand Prismatic Spring, Lake Yellowstone, and more. Stops include Upper Geyser Basin, Grand Prismatic Spring, Yellowstone Lake, Old Faithful, Lower Yellowstone River Falls, Midway Geyser Basin. Stop for an included lunch and many photo ops throughout the day. Ideal for travelers basing in Jackson Hole who want a guided Wyoming outing without self-driving mountain roads.
